newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-BERGKAMP EXTENDS CONTRACT AT ARSENAL.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BERGKAMP EXTENDS CONTRACT AT ARSENAL.

text.p: Dutch international striker Dennis Bergkamp has agreed to sign a new contract at English premier league club Arsenal but the London side look likely to lose international midfielder Paul Merson.
The club said on Saturday that the 28-year-old Bergkamp was set to sign a deal which would keep the former Ajax Amsterdam and Internazionale Milan player at Arsenal until the end of his career.
But manager Arsene Wenger has agreed to let England international Merson have talks with relegated Middlesbrough in the next few days.
If they can agree personal terms, the 29-year-old Merson looks almost certain to play in the first division next season.
Wenger has been very active in the transfer market in the close season as he bids to build a new young squad.
Talented Dutch winger Marc Overmars has joined the club from Ajax together with 19-year-old Portugese striker Luis Boamorte and Frenchmen Emmanuel Petit and Gilles Grimaldi.
